Update users list to use server role filter and new helpers

result:
The users page now has a search box, a role filter and an Export CSV button, but nothing has been run: no tests, lint, type-check or app, as you asked.

- **Search**: filters the loaded list as you type, matching full name or email, case-insensitive.
- **Role filter**: "All roles / Admin / User". The role goes to the API as a `role` query param on `GET /users`, and I extended the MSW mock handler to honour it. The current list stays on screen while the new role loads.
- **Export CSV**: downloads `users.csv` with the rows currently shown, with columns Name, Email, Role, Joined. It is disabled when no rows are shown or while a role change is loading.
- **Access**: all of this sits inside the existing admin-only `<Authorization>` on the route, so non-admins see none of it.

Things you might not expect:

- **Role filter is server-side, search is client-side.** The project hook rejects any `user.role` comparison in feature code, so I moved the role filter to the API rather than filter rows in the browser. A real backend must support `?role=ADMIN|USER`.
- **Joined date format** is the app's `formatDate` output (for example "January 15, 2024 9:30 AM"), because the hook forbids using a date library outside `@/utils/format`. For the same reason the filename has no date stamp. If you want an ISO date in the CSV, that needs a new formatter in `@/utils/format`.
- **Formula protection**: cells that start with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` get a leading `'` so a spreadsheet does not run a user-supplied name as a formula.
- **No `Form` wrapper**: the filter fields are the shared `Input` and `Select` driven by component state, not a `Form` with a Zod schema, since nothing is submitted.

I also added tests: `src/app/routes/app/__tests__/users.test.tsx` (search, role filter, export), `src/utils/__tests__/csv.test.ts` and `src/features/users/utils/__tests__/users-csv.test.ts`.

The main changes are in `src/features/users/components/users-list.tsx`, `users-filters.tsx` beside it, `src/features/users/api/get-users.ts` and `src/utils/csv.ts`.
